key_concepts: Electric current is the amount of charge passing a point per unit time
Current is calculated using I = Q/t
Electric current is measured in amperes
Electric charge is measured in coulombs
A closed circuit provides a complete conducting path for current
An open circuit has a break so current cannot flow
Basic circuit components include a source, wires, load or resistor, and switch
Schematic diagrams use standard symbols to represent circuit components
Ohm’s law relates voltage, current, and resistance as V = IR
Voltage is measured in volts and resistance in ohms
For constant resistance, increasing voltage increases current
For constant voltage, increasing resistance decreases current
